title: salix nigricans var. undulata
intro: Salix nigricans var. undulata, commonly known as the black willow, is a variety of the black willow tree, native to North America. It is valued for its bark, which contains salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, providing relief from pain, fever, and inflammation. The health benefits of Salix nigricans var. undulata include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce swelling. The therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, while its bioactive constituents include salicin, salicylic acid, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
